definition: Notepad/text-editor window or visible screen reproduction of it; no OCR, blank/partially occluded editors count. Browser articles, chat, calculators and spreadsheet pages do not. Ambiguous tiny windows excluded.
split_note: Training VODs predate the Sep-27 test event. Test channels are not in training. Test channels share a broadcast event and are not statistically independent. Sampled uniform frames plus old-head retrieval; not exhaustive recall.
